Name: Kalskag Coalition
Details:
At the time of Operation STILETTO, the Kalskag Coalition was the most powerful political faction on Acamar, led by Calvin Noru.  It controlled the capital, Kalskag, and dominated the region until the operation and internal conflicts began to dismantle its power.

The four involved factions were:
	Jacob's Juggernauts;
	Band Of The Damned;
	Connor's Ransackers; and
	Robert's Dreaded.
This is along with a principal supporter Acamar Provisional Cavalry commanded by Grim Determination, wearing their colors as respect.
